title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
title_zh: WorkFactory：将职业意图转化为可执行工作以实现可扩展的智能体训练

paragraphs.en: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. All three models improve over their respective base models across four professional-work benchmarks, with WorkPilot-35B-A3B improving from 879 to 1565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. Scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns, with execution length first increasing and then decreasing. Controlled component analyses show that planning and repair reduce probe-diagnosed task environment defects and improve downstream performance. The data and models are available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory .
paragraphs.zh: 为工作中的智能体扩展监督训练，需要能产生可靠专家示范的多样化专业任务。 然而，任务信息缺失或不一致会阻碍教师执行并削弱由此产生的监督信号。 我们提出 WorkFactory，一个用于构建连贯且可执行的专业任务的可扩展框架。 从专业意图出发，信息级规划构建信息支持图来引导任务实例化，显式表示预期输出所需信息的依赖关系和位置。 随后通过探针执行来识别支持故障并指导修复，同时保留预期的工作内容。 我们构建了覆盖 612 个职业的 112,686 个任务，并利用收集的教师轨迹对 4B、27B 和 35B-A3B 规模的 Qwen 模型进行微调，得到 WorkPilot 系列模型。 在四个专业工作基准上，三个模型均优于各自的基座模型，其中 WorkPilot-35B-A3B 在 GDPval-AA v2.1 上的 Elo 分数从 879 提升至 1565。 扩展分析揭示了依赖于模型的收益递减现象，执行长度先增加后减少。 受控的组件分析表明，规划与修复减少了经探针诊断出的任务环境缺陷，并提升了下游性能。 数据和模型可在 https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory 获取。

paragraphs.en: Language agents interleave reasoning and actions to interact with external environments [ 36 ] . Working agents extend this paradigm to professional work in digital environments, executing workflows, coordinating tools, and producing deliverables across diverse occupations [ 23 , 17 ] . This shift creates opportunities for agents to improve productivity and generate real economic value [ 18 ] . A common approach to agent post-training is supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations of task execution [ 30 , 10 ] . Scaling this approach to working agents requires diverse executable professional tasks spanning a wide range of occupational competencies.

paragraphs.en: Recent frameworks automate professional task construction by retrieving, reusing, adapting, or synthesizing task-relevant materials [ 12 ] , and then collect teacher trajectories for supervision [ 40 ] . The value of scaling task construction, however, depends on whether the resulting teacher trajectories reliably demonstrate the target occupational competencies. To produce effective demonstrations, a teacher agent needs access to sufficient and consistent information for carrying out the intended work. Establishing this support is challenging because the information required for an intended output may be distributed across multiple artifacts and connected through intermediate calculations and judgments. For example, a supplier-selection task may provide demand forecasts and vendor quotations in separate files but omit whether one vendor’s price includes freight. Without this pricing condition, lifecycle costs cannot be computed and compared consistently; yet providing the computed costs directly would remove a substantive part of the work the teacher is expected to perform. Constructing such an environment therefore requires a careful boundary: all necessary premises must be available, while intermediate and final results must remain for the teacher to derive. Otherwise, the teacher may introduce unsupported assumptions or leave essential work incomplete, weakening the resulting trajectory as training supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的框架通过检索、复用、适配或综合与任务相关的材料来构建专业任务 [ 12 ] ，随后收集教师轨迹用于监督 [ 40 ] 。 然而，扩展任务构建的价值取决于所得到的教师轨迹是否能够可靠地展示目标职业能力。 为了产出有效的示范，教师智能体需要获得充分且一致的信息来执行预定的工作。 建立这种支持颇具挑战性，因为生成目标输出所需的信息可能分布在多个工件中，并通过中间计算和判断相互关联。 例如，一个供应商选择任务可能在不同文件中分别提供需求预测和供应商报价，却没有说明某个供应商的价格是否包含运费。 缺少这一价格条件，就无法一致地计算和比较全生命周期成本；然而，直接提供已计算的成本又会剥夺教师智能体本应完成的一部分实质性工作。 因此，构建这样的环境需要仔细划定边界：所有必要的前提必须可用，而中间结果和最终结果必须留给教师智能体来推导。 否则，教师智能体可能引入缺乏依据的假设，或遗漏关键工作，从而削弱所得轨迹作为训练监督的价值。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing executable tasks that support reliable demonstrations of professional work. We derive diverse professional intents by combining occupational knowledge, skill documentation, and professional artifacts, broadening the range of work that can be instantiated. For each intent, WorkFactory plans backward from the intended output using an information support graph. Rather than connecting artifacts alone, the graph captures what each output depends on and where the supporting information should be available across reused and synthesized materials, while leaving derived results to the solver. To catch violations introduced during materialization, an isolated probe attempts the task from solver-visible inputs; its diagnoses drive repairs that must restore support without changing the intended work. Only environments that pass this process are then assigned to an independent teacher, whose execution provides the training trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 WorkFactory，一个用于构建可执行任务的可扩展框架，支持对专业工作进行可靠的演示。 我们通过结合职业知识、技能文档和专业工件来推导出多样化的专业意图，拓宽了可实例化的工作范围。 针对每个意图，WorkFactory 使用信息支持图从预期输出出发进行反向规划。 该图并非仅仅连接工件，而是刻画每个输出依赖什么、以及支持信息应在哪些被复用和合成的材料中可用，同时将推导结果留给求解器处理。 为了捕获在物化过程中引入的违规问题，一个隔离的探针从求解器可见的输入出发尝试该任务；其诊断结果驱动修复，修复必须在不改变预期工作的前提下恢复支持。 只有通过该流程的环境才会被分配给一个独立的教师，由其执行过程提供训练轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic task and environment construction has become an important approach to scaling agent training. Software engineering provides a favorable setting, where repositories offer realistic contexts and executable tests provide concrete supervision; representative systems include SWE-Gym [ 22 ] , SWE-smith [ 35 ] , and R2E-Gym [ 14 ] . Beyond coding, recent work synthesizes longer-horizon, multi-tool tasks through compositional expansion [ 34 , 29 ] , environment exploration and execution feedback [ 28 , 7 ] , and stateful interaction environments [ 11 ] . These advances motivate synthesis for working agents, whose tasks require coherent workspaces that integrate heterogeneous information and domain-specific deliverables.

paragraphs.en: NexForge [ 40 ] translates capability requirements into task directives and instantiates them through workspace blueprints, while Synthetic Computers [ 12 ] plans dependencies among artifacts to guide workspace synthesis. In concurrent work, GraphForge [ 31 ] constructs evidence graphs over real files to derive task statements and evidence-anchored rubrics, then revises these specifications using execution feedback. WorkGenesis [ 42 ] synthesizes companion materials around retrieved files and uses rubric-based failure attribution to guide revisions to the request, synthesized materials, and rubric. Whereas GraphForge compiles tasks and rubrics from an evidence graph over an assembled real-file workspace, WorkFactory works backward from intended outputs, using its graph to coordinate information dependencies and locations across reused and synthesized materials while leaving derived results to the solver. Unlike WorkGenesis’s rubric-based audit, WorkFactory directly probes the solver-visible environment and constrains repair to preserve the intended work.

paragraphs.en: WorkFactory constructs executable professional tasks for training working agents. It first builds a diverse intent library from occupational knowledge, skill documentation, and professional artifacts, allowing task construction to cover both established workflows and realistic deliverables (§ 3.2 ). For each intent, WorkFactory plans backward from the intended output using an information support graph, which coordinates dependencies and information locations across reused and synthesized materials while reserving derived results for the solver (§ 3.3 ). Because these dependencies may be lost or contradicted when the environment is materialized, execution-based repair probes the task from solver-visible inputs and repairs blocking support failures without changing the intended work (§ 3.4 ). Tasks that pass this process are assigned to an independent teacher for trajectory collection (§ 3.5 ). Figure 2 illustrates the process through a supplier-selection example.
paragraphs.zh: WorkFactory 为训练工作中的智能体构建可执行的专业任务。 它首先从职业知识、技能文档和专业制品中构建多样化的意图库，使任务构建既能覆盖既定工作流程，也能覆盖真实可交付成果（§ 3.2 ）。 对于每个意图，WorkFactory 基于信息支持图从预期输出出发进行反向规划，该图协调复用与合成材料之间的依赖关系和信息位置，同时为求解器保留派生结果（§ 3.3 ）。 由于这些依赖关系在环境实体化时可能丢失或相互矛盾，基于执行的修复机制从求解器可见的输入出发对任务进行探测，在不改变预期工作的情况下修复阻断性的支持失败（§ 3.4 ）。 通过该流程的任务会被分配给一个独立的教师进行轨迹收集（§ 3.5 ）。 图 2 通过一个供应商选择示例展示了该流程。

paragraphs.en: Professional intents specify meaningful work before its instance-specific materials are fixed. To cover varied occupational competencies, WorkFactory draws on three different sources: (1) occupational hierarchies , which ground the work in roles and situations; (2) documented skills , which identify operations that can be composed into workflows; and (3) real professional deliverables , which provide cues about intended outputs and audiences. The three synthesis routes reflect these roles: we expand occupations into roles situated in professional contexts, compose skills when one operation supplies inputs for another, and infer plausible objectives from deliverables through instruction backtranslation [ 16 ] . An LLM-based review evaluates candidate intents from all three routes for internal coherence and feasibility, professional appropriateness, and plausibility as real workplace activities before adding them to the shared intent library ℒ \mathcal{L} . This offline library supplies intents for environment construction; Appendix A details the synthesis routes.
paragraphs.zh: 专业意图在其具体实例材料确定之前，就对有意义的工作作出规定。 为了覆盖多样的职业能力，WorkFactory 借助三种不同的来源：(1) 职业层级，将工作置于角色和情境之中；(2) 成文技能，识别可组合为工作流的操作；(3) 真实的专业交付物，为预期产出和受众提供线索。 这三条综合路径正对应这些作用：我们将职业扩展为处于专业情境中的角色，在某项操作为另一操作提供输入时组合技能，并通过指令回译 [16] 从交付物中推断出合理的目标。 基于 LLM 的审查会评估来自这三条路径的候选意图的内部连贯性与可行性、专业适宜性，以及作为真实职场活动的合理性，之后才将其加入共享意图库 ℒ \mathcal{L}。 该离线库为环境构建提供意图；附录 A 详细介绍了这些综合路径。

Each requested output must be supported by a complete chain of solver-visible premises, while the calculations and judgments that constitute the intended work must remain for the solver to perform. paragraphs.en: For each intent in ℒ \mathcal{L} , the planner starts from the intended output and works backward. Each node records its content, entity and scope, and whether it is supplied, externally acquired, solver-derived, or internal to construction. paragraphs.en: The planner translates the graph into an artifact-level construction plan 𝒫 = ( u , 𝒜 , 𝒟 ) \mathcal{P}=(u,\mathcal{A},\mathcal{D}) , comprising the concrete user request u u , artifact specifications 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , and acyclic construction dependencies 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . An environment worker follows this plan to reuse, adapt, or synthesize artifacts. Carrier bindings guide content placement, while information relations and shared identities and scopes guide consistency across files. paragraphs.en: A probe solver attempts the task using only the solver-visible request and resources, without access to the graph, construction plan, or prior execution outputs and diagnoses. It grounds reported environmental issues in inspected sources and tool observations, identifies the affected operations and deliverables, and distinguishes them from solver mistakes and legitimate open choices. paragraphs.en: A refiner uses the diagnoses to edit the request and existing reference files while preserving the files’ number, types, and dependency structure; the information support graph remains the initial construction specification. For example, adding a missing USD 0.15-per-carton freight term for Supplier C restores the support needed for an NPV comparison without performing the comparison for the solver. Each revision must pass construction checks and an LLM-based work-preservation review against the original intent and initial plan, assessing whether the core objective, essential operations, and substantive deliverable requirements remain intact. Revised tasks that fail either check are discarded; those that pass undergo a fresh probe execution. The loop stops when no blocker remains or the repair budget is exhausted, with unresolved tasks discarded. Retained tasks form the candidate pool 𝒯 \mathcal{T} for trajectory collection. Appendix C.2 specifies the repair constraints and budget, and Appendix D.3 provides model and execution settings.

paragraphs.en: For every task in 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , GLM-5.3 [ 38 ] independently attempts the task in a clean sandbox with the same task-information access boundary as the probe in § 3.4 . The teacher receives the current request and accessible resources, without the information support graph, construction plan, or prior probe outputs and diagnoses. The resulting interaction trace and produced deliverables form an initial teacher rollout. We retain rollouts that pass lightweight filters screening for repeated reasoning, repeated tool calls, and missing or insufficiently substantive deliverables. For the 5% of tasks with the longest initial rollouts, measured by total interaction turns, we additionally apply selective rejection sampling based on pairwise deliverable comparisons; all other tasks retain their filtered initial rollouts. Each retained rollout is then converted into one or more training sequences for masked autoregressive supervision. 1 1 1 Context compaction and sub-agent strategy may split a rollout into multiple training sequences. Appendix D.3 details the execution settings, rejection-sampling procedure, and training configuration.

paragraphs.en: We compare the three WorkPilot models with their corresponding base models: Qwen3.5-4B [ 24 ] , Qwen3.6-27B [ 25 ] , and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 26 ] . paragraphs.en: We evaluate the training utility of WorkFactory teacher trajectories on GDPval [ 23 ] , JobBench [ 17 ] , Workspace-Bench [ 32 ] 2 2 2 Following the official recommendation, we use Workspace-Bench-Lite for evaluation efficiency. , and OmegaUse-OfficeVal [ 41 ] . For the remaining benchmarks, we use the Claude Code harness [ 2 ] with Claude Sonnet 4.6 [ 3 ] as the judge when needed and report the official metrics. 3 3 3 Since the GLM-5.3 teacher supports text input only, we train and evaluate WorkPilot in text-only mode; the native vision and alignment components of its Qwen backbones remain unused.

paragraphs.en: We compare three 5K-task synthesis conditions: direct artifact-level planning, information-level planning, and information-level planning followed by execution-based repair. The analysis asks whether explicitly planning and repairing task information improves both the conditions for teacher execution and the training utility of the resulting trajectories. We assess task-environment quality using blocker- and correctness-level findings from a common probe solver (see § 3.4 ) and downstream utility by fine-tuning the same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model under the shared training configuration. For each defect category, incidence is the fraction of tasks whose report contains at least one hard defect in that category; categories may overlap. We use the initial probe report for the first two conditions and the final report for the repair condition, including tasks later discarded for unresolved blockers. Table 3 summarizes both analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较三种 5K 任务合成条件：直接在产物层面进行规划、在信息层面进行规划，以及在信息层面规划后进行基于执行的修复。 该分析旨在探讨显式地规划和修复任务信息是否能同时改善教师执行的条件以及所生成轨迹的训练效用。 我们使用同一探测求解器（见 § 3.4）得出的阻塞级和正确性级发现来评估任务-环境质量，并通过在共享训练配置下微调同一个 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 基座模型来评估下游效用。 对于每个缺陷类别，发生率为其报告中在该类别包含至少一个硬缺陷的任务所占比例；各类别之间可能重叠。 对于前两种条件，我们使用初始探测报告；对于修复条件，我们使用最终报告，其中包括后来因未解决的阻塞问题而被丢弃的任务。 表 3 总结了这两项分析。

paragraphs.en: Replacing direct artifact-level planning with information-level planning reduces probe-diagnosed hard-defect incidence in six of the eight categories. The largest reduction is in broken derivations, from 24.86% to 6.86%, while underspecified requests fall from 7.22% to 0.62%. These changes are consistent with the graph’s role in making required information and its locations explicit. However, the incidence of leakage or shortcuts and self-inconsistency increases by 1.44 and 1.18 percentage points, respectively. We hypothesize that the former may arise when explicit dependencies lead the materializer to expose solver-derived information in the request, and the latter when denser constraints make it harder to maintain consistency across synthesized statements and values. These regressions show that making information requirements explicit does not by itself ensure that materialization preserves them. Adding execution-based repair reduces the reported incidence in all eight categories relative to information-level planning alone. In particular, cross-file inconsistency falls from 25.74% to 4.84%, execution-feasibility defects from 6.64% to 0.48%, and leakage or shortcuts from 3.36% to 0.84%. Taken together, these reductions show that execution-based repair complements information-level planning by addressing defects that remain in the materialized environments. Appendix C.3 provides additional repair statistics.

paragraphs.en: We train the same model separately on teacher trajectories from each synthesis condition. paragraphs.en: We introduced WorkFactory, a framework for constructing executable professional tasks to support teacher demonstrations of occupational competencies. Information-level planning specifies the dependencies and locations of required information, while execution-based repair addresses support failures exposed during task execution. Using teacher trajectories from 112,686 tasks, we trained the WorkPilot family, whose three models improve over their corresponding bases across four professional-work benchmarks. Data-scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns and changes in execution length and tool-use reliability. Controlled component studies connect reductions in probe-diagnosed environment defects to improved downstream training utility, supporting the value of coherent task construction for scaling working-agent supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorkFactory，一个用于构建可执行职业任务以支持教师展示职业能力的框架。 信息级规划规定所需信息的依赖关系与位置，而基于执行的修复则处理任务执行过程中暴露的支持性失败。 利用来自 112,686 个任务的教师轨迹，我们训练了 WorkPilot 系列模型，其三个模型在四个职业工作基准上均优于各自对应的基础模型。 数据规模扩展分析揭示了随模型而异的边际收益递减，以及执行长度和工具使用可靠性的变化。 受控组件研究将探针诊断出的环境缺陷减少与下游训练效用的提升联系起来，支持了一致性任务构建在扩展工作智能体监督方面的价值。

paragraphs.en: First, GLM-5.3, our teacher model, accepts only text input. Consequently, although the Qwen backbones include native vision and alignment components, we train and evaluate them only through a text-only task-solving interface. This work therefore does not examine learning from visual evidence directly. Future work will extend trajectory collection and student training to multimodal professional tasks. Second, our training study focuses on supervised fine-tuning over teacher trajectories. Future work will leverage high-quality professional tasks and their execution feedback to train working agents with reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，GLM-5.3 作为我们的教师模型，仅接受文本输入。 因此，尽管 Qwen 骨干模型包含原生视觉与对齐组件，我们仅通过纯文本的任务求解接口对它们进行训练和评估。 因此，本工作并未直接考察从视觉证据中学习。 未来的工作将把轨迹收集和学生模型训练扩展到多模态专业任务。 其次，我们的训练研究聚焦于对教师轨迹进行监督微调。 未来的工作将利用高质量的专业任务及其执行反馈，通过强化学习训练工作型智能体。

paragraphs.en: WorkFactory trains agents to perform professional workflows and produce realistic workplace artifacts. Such outputs may be incorrect, biased, or misused in consequential settings, and should therefore receive appropriate human review rather than replace qualified professionals. paragraphs.en: Starting from a public occupational hierarchy derived from the Standard Occupational Classification [ 33 ] , we expand broad occupations into fine-grained roles. These roles seed a search agent that retrieves professional context from the web as needed and generates work situations and objectives grounded in role responsibilities, business settings, and motivating events.

paragraphs.en: We collect documented skills from a public skill directory 4 4 4 https://skills.sh/ and analyze each skill’s purpose, applicability conditions, prerequisites, and operations to derive work situations and objectives. We combine skills into candidate multi-step workflows when one skill’s output can supply inputs required by another and the operations jointly serve a coherent professional objective. For example, quotation extraction supplies supplier cost inputs for annual cash-flow modeling, whose results feed NPV comparison and sourcing recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一个公开技能目录 4 4 4 https://skills.sh/ 收集有文档记录的技能，并分析每个技能的用途、适用条件、前置要求和操作，以推导工作情境与目标。 当一个技能的输出能够提供另一个技能所需的输入，且这些操作共同服务于一个连贯的职业目标时，我们将技能组合成候选的多步骤工作流。 例如，报价提取为年度现金流建模提供供应商成本输入，其结果进一步用于 NPV 对比与采购建议。

paragraphs.en: WorkFactory represents the information required by a task together with the artifacts that provide or receive it. The representation distinguishes a planned output or internal construction requirement from information already available to the solver. Internal construction requirements serve only as an intermediate specification during synthesis, connecting the intended work to the request and supporting materials. They contain no instance-specific facts and add no obligations unavailable to the solver. All goals, constraints, and instance-specific information needed for completion must be expressed in or obtainable through solver-accessible inputs.
paragraphs.zh: WorkFactory 表示任务所需的信息，以及提供或接收该信息的人工制品。 该表示区分了计划的输出或内部构造需求与求解器已可获得的信息。 内部构造需求仅在综合过程中作为中间规范，将预期的工作与请求和支持材料连接起来。 它们不包含任何特定于实例的事实，也不会增加求解器无法承担的义务。 完成所需的全部目标、约束条件和特定于实例的信息，都必须表达在求解器可访问的输入中，或可通过其获得。

paragraphs.en: An information node records semantic content, entity and scope, and provision status: supplied, externally acquired, solver-derived, or internal to construction. It also records carrier bindings specifying where the content is supplied, acquired, or produced. Solver-derived nodes describe quantities or outputs to be derived and their supporting relations; their values remain to be determined by the solver. Table 4 summarizes the principal roles. A relation is r = ( S r , v r , ρ r ) r=(S_{r},v_{r},\rho_{r}) , where source nodes S r S_{r} jointly support target node v r v_{r} under relation ρ r \rho_{r} . Relations capture reference and consistency, entity association, scope and applicability, calculation, evidence support, constraints, and requirement fulfillment. paragraphs.en: The artifact-level construction plan 𝒫 = ( u , 𝒜 , 𝒟 ) \mathcal{P}=(u,\mathcal{A},\mathcal{D}) contains the concrete user request and deliverable requirements u u , artifact specifications 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , and acyclic construction dependencies 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . Each artifact specification records its role, format, required content, provenance, and materialization route: reuse, adaptation, or synthesis. The environment worker receives both the information support graph and this plan as text in its planning context, and materializes all required artifacts within a single agent session. The worker reuses suitable real artifacts, modifies them when adaptation is needed, and synthesizes components when usable sources lack required information or the task requires a controlled condition such as a resolvable conflict. Artifact construction dependencies specify when one file needs content from another. The worker follows these dependencies as prerequisite constraints in its prompt when deciding the construction order. Other information relations remain constraints in the shared planning context and may be mutual. Programmatic checks compare planned and generated file counts and types. LLM-based review assesses content coverage and the coherence of the user request, including its references to all provided reference files. During initial materialization, failed checks trigger up to three automatic construction retries after the initial attempt, stopping when the checks pass; tasks that still fail at the limit are discarded. Passing the construction checks does not establish that every semantic dependency is satisfied; execution feedback supplies an additional check on the realized environment.

paragraphs.en: Runtime quality assessment reports describe issues and assign severity labels. A probe solver is informed that the task is synthetic and instructed to produce the best feasible deliverable. It grounds each diagnosis in inspected sources and tool observations, identifies affected operations and deliverable requirements, and distinguishes environmental defects from solver mistakes and legitimate open choices. Severity labels distinguish blocker findings that prevent completion of the minimum required deliverable, correctness findings that identify concrete task errors, efficiency findings that suggest better processes, and open observations that record non-binding risks or suggestions. Only blocker findings trigger repair, although a triggered repair may also address correctness-level and other reported issues. Tasks with only non-blocking findings skip repair; efficiency and open findings are advisory. Non-blocking errors may therefore remain in retained tasks, and unclassified findings do not enter the eight-category table.

paragraphs.en: For the component analysis, we retrospectively categorize the issues described in these reports by their content and supporting evidence. The eight categories in Table 6 are therefore analysis labels, separate from the severity labels used to trigger repair. In particular, the category Execution feasibility describes execution-related obstacles; blocker-severity issues can also concern missing evidence, inconsistent materials, or other categories. Blocker and correctness findings are treated as hard defects in the incidence analysis. Task-level incidence counts a task once per category if its selected report contains at least one finding labeled blocker or correctness in that category; a task may appear in multiple categories. Classification uses the report’s stated evidence, not solver failure alone. Table 3 uses the initial report (round 0) for the artifact-level and information-level planning conditions and the final report for the execution-based repair condition, including tasks subsequently discarded for unresolved blockers.

paragraphs.en: The original professional intent and the initial construction plan are the references for reviewing whether a repaired task retains its core objective, essential operations, and substantive deliverable requirements. Minor changes to the work’s scope or details are permitted when restoring the conditions needed for completion; the initial plan is a reference for the intended work, rather than a requirement to preserve every instance detail. The refiner directly edits the request u u and the contents of existing reference files specified by 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , without updating the information support graph. Its prompt requires the number, dependency relations, and types of reference files to remain unchanged. For example, adding the missing Supplier C freight term of USD 0.15 per carton preserves the lifecycle-sourcing objective, whereas dropping the vendor NPV comparison or supplying a completed recommendation removes essential work. This separate LLM-based review is applied after each repair, rather than during initial materialization; tasks that require no repair do not undergo it.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的专业意图和初始构建方案是审查修复后的任务是否保留其核心目标、关键操作和实质性交付要求的依据。 在恢复完成任务所需条件时，允许对工作的范围或细节做小幅调整；初始方案是对预期工作的参考，而非要求保留每一处实例细节。 优化器（refiner）直接编辑请求 u u 以及 𝒜 \mathcal{A} 所指定的现有参考文件的内容，而不更新信息支持图。 其提示词要求参考文件的数量、依赖关系和类型保持不变。 例如，补充缺失的供应商 C 每箱 0.15 美元运费条款保持了全生命周期采购的目标；而删去供应商 NPV 对比或直接给出已完成的建议，则移除了关键工作内容。 这一基于大语言模型（LLM）的独立审查在每次修复之后进行，而非在初始实体化过程中进行；无需修复的任务不经历该审查。

paragraphs.en: Each revision also undergoes the construction checks in Appendix B.3 . Revised tasks that fail construction or work-preservation checks are discarded. Likewise, conflicting records can be legitimate inputs when resolving the conflict is part of the intended work. Information repeated across carriers should otherwise agree in identity, scope, and value. The representation specifies supporting evidence and constraints without prescribing a unique judgment or execution strategy.

paragraphs.en: The component analysis in § 4.4 compares three 5K-task synthesis conditions: direct artifact-level planning, information-level planning, and information-level planning followed by execution-based repair. It evaluates pre-training environment quality using hard defects identified by a common probe solver and downstream utility by training the same student model under each condition. This subsection further characterizes the repair condition by reporting repair depth and paired probe execution statistics on the same 5K-task analysis set. Table 7 summarizes both views.

paragraphs.en: The following synthetic instance traces the running example from planning to training. paragraphs.en: Evaluation tasks are not exposed to WorkFactory during intent synthesis or task-environment construction. As a post-hoc safeguard, we encode the user request of every retained training task and every evaluation task with Qwen3-Embedding-8B [ 39 ] and flag pairs with cosine similarity of at least 0.85. Separately, we flag pairs when shared 10-grams cover at least 20% of the tokens in the shorter request. We also compare hashes of the solver-visible files in the training and evaluation environments to detect byte-identical artifacts. All request pairs flagged by either text-overlap criterion are manually reviewed to distinguish reuse of an evaluation task from benign similarity in domain, occupation, or deliverable type. No reviewed pair constitutes task reuse, and no file hash is shared between the training and evaluation environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在意图合成或任务-环境构建过程中，评估任务不会暴露给 WorkFactory。 作为一种事后保障措施，我们使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B [39] 对每个保留的训练任务和每个评估任务的用户请求进行编码，并标记余弦相似度不低于 0.85 的配对。 另外，当共享的 10-gram 覆盖较短请求中至少 20% 的词元时，我们也会标记这类配对。 我们还会比较训练环境与评估环境中求解器可见文件的哈希值，以检测字节完全相同的产物。 所有被任一文本重叠标准标记的请求配对都会经过人工审查，以区分评估任务的复用与领域、职业或交付物类型上的良性相似。 经审查的配对中没有构成任务复用的情况，训练环境与评估环境之间也没有共享的文件哈希。

paragraphs.en: Every probe execution, including re-diagnosis after repair, starts in a clean sandbox with the current visible request and resources. The probe runs in the Claude Code harness with a 1M-token context window and no context compaction. It cannot access internal construction requirements, the information support graph, the construction plan, or outputs and reports from previous executions. Teacher executions share this task-information access boundary and use a 256K-token context window. We collect trajectories for 94,077 tasks with the GDPval-AA Stirrup harness [ 5 ] and for the remaining 18,609 with Claude Code [ 2 ] . Stirrup runs use the GDPval-AA tools and official context-compaction mechanism 5 5 5 https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking#gdpval-aa , whereas Claude Code runs use its native tools and a compaction threshold of 0.7. Their prompts differ: the teacher attempts the task, while the probe also reports environmental issues encountered while solving.
paragraphs.zh: 每次探针执行（包括修复后的重新诊断）都在一个干净的沙箱中启动，仅使用当前可见的请求和资源。 探针在 Claude Code 框架中运行，配备 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，且不进行上下文压缩。 它无法访问内部构建要求、信息支持图、构建计划，或先前执行的输出与报告。 教师执行共享同样的任务信息访问边界，并使用 25.6 万 token 的上下文窗口。 我们为 94,077 个任务收集轨迹时使用 GDPval-AA Stirrup 框架 [ 5 ]，对其余 18,609 个任务则使用 Claude Code [ 2 ]。 Stirrup 运行使用 GDPval-AA 工具和官方上下文压缩机制 5 5 5 https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking#gdpval-aa，而 Claude Code 运行使用其原生工具，压缩阈值设为 0.7。 两者的提示词不同：教师尝试完成任务，而探针还会报告解题过程中遇到的环境问题。

paragraphs.en: Every initial teacher rollout undergoes programmatic validity checks. We exclude rollouts that contain repeated reasoning spans or repeated tool calls, fail to produce a deliverable, or produce deliverables below a minimum content threshold. These corpus-wide checks target degenerate or incomplete executions; they do not provide task-specific judgments of deliverable correctness.

paragraphs.en: For each selected task, the pairwise judge reads the user request, reference artifacts, and both agents’ deliverables, without access to the internal construction requirements. A DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 baseline deliverable is generated once per task and held fixed across comparisons. A teacher win retains the corresponding rollout. If the initial teacher attempt loses or ties, we allow up to three additional attempts (four teacher attempts in total), stopping at the first win. Each retry starts in a clean sandbox with the same task inputs and generation settings, without access to previous attempts or judge feedback. A task contributes no training episode if none of its attempts wins; that task and its workspace are excluded from the final corpus. Tasks outside the selected subset retain their initial teacher episodes after lightweight filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被选中的任务，成对评审器会阅读用户请求、参考产物以及两个智能体的交付成果，但无法访问内部构建要求。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 基线交付成果每个任务只生成一次，并在各次比较中保持不变。 教师模型获胜时保留对应的推演结果。 如果教师模型的首次尝试失败或打平，我们允许最多三次额外尝试（共四次教师模型尝试），并在首次获胜时停止。 每次重试都在一个干净的沙箱中进行，使用相同的任务输入和生成设置，且无法访问先前的尝试或评审反馈。 如果某任务的所有尝试都未获胜，则该任务不产生任何训练回合；该任务及其工作区会被排除出最终语料库。 所选子集之外的任务在经过轻量级过滤后保留其初始教师模型回合。

paragraphs.en: Students trained on trajectories from either teacher substantially outperform the 879-Elo base model, showing that the gains from WorkFactory training are not exclusive to GLM-5.3 supervision. On the matched training tasks, GLM-5.3 uses more assistant turns and tool calls than DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 despite comparable reasoning-token counts. paragraphs.en: You are the pairwise evaluator for GDPVal-AA. Determine which blinded submission better fulfills the original professional task. Evaluate both submissions using all available evidence from the initial task, reference files, extracted file text, rendered document images, native media, and submission files. Consider correctness, completeness, usability, professional quality, and faithfulness to requested deliverables. Rules: 1. The identities of the systems are intentionally hidden. Never infer model identity from style, filenames, metadata, or self-description, and never favor Submission A or B because of its position. 2. Inspect both submissions independently before comparing them. Missing, empty, corrupt, or unusable deliverables are substantive failures. 3. For factual or pointable claims, rely on evidence actually present in the submitted artifacts. A submission’s claim that it is correct is not proof. 4. For visual deliverables, use rendered images as well as extracted text. When visible rendering conflicts with extraction, trust the visible artifact. 5. Use tie only when the submissions are genuinely equivalent overall or the available evidence cannot support a defensible preference. Do not use a tie merely because each submission has different strengths. 6. Check all material requirements in the original task, but keep the response concise. Return only the most decision-relevant comparisons. Return exactly one JSON object containing (i) a winner in {A, B, tie}, (ii) a concise evidence-grounded overall explanation, and (iii) at most ten decisive comparisons. Each decisive comparison contains the relevant criterion, which submission is better, and a short specific evidence pointer for each submission. Return valid JSON without Markdown or surrounding text, and do not include model names, guessed identities, Elo ratings, pointwise scores, or hidden metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 你是 GDPVal-AA 的成对评审员。 判断哪一份匿名提交的答卷更好地完成了原始的专业任务。 利用初始任务、参考文件、提取的文件文本、渲染的文档图像、原生媒体和提交文件中所有可用的证据来评审两份答卷。 考虑正确性、完整性、可用性、专业质量以及对所要求交付物的忠实度。规则：1. 系统的身份被有意隐藏。 绝不要从风格、文件名、元数据或自我描述中推断模型身份，也绝不要因为位置而偏袒提交 A 或提交 B。2. 在比较两份答卷之前，先独立查看每一份答卷。 缺失、空白、损坏或不可用的交付物属于实质性失败。3. 对于事实性或有据可查的主张，应依据提交材料中实际存在的证据。 答卷声称自己正确并不能作为证明。4. 对于视觉类交付物，应同时使用渲染图像和提取的文本。 当可见的渲染结果与文本提取结果冲突时，以可见的成品为准。5. 只有当两份答卷整体上确实相当，或现有证据无法支持一个有依据的偏好时，才使用平局。 不要仅仅因为两份答卷各有优劣就判定平局。6. 检查原始任务中的所有实质性要求，但回复要简洁。 只返回与决策最相关的比较。 返回恰好一个 JSON 对象，其中包含：(i) {A, B, tie} 中的获胜者，(ii) 基于证据的简洁总体说明，以及 (iii) 最多十条决定性比较。 每条决定性比较包含相关评判标准、哪份答卷更好，以及针对每份答卷的简短具体证据指针。 返回不含 Markdown 或前后其他文字的有效 JSON，并且不要包含模型名称、猜测的身份、Elo 评分、逐点评分或隐藏元数据。
